answer: One concrete defense binds each agent identity to a physically distinct network vantage. To enlist, an agent answers random latency probes from many points at once; a single host cloning a thousand identities cannot forge a thousand independent round-trip fingerprints, since one signal cannot thread through two routes at the same instant. Validators correlate the traces as they flow together like a river, and any cluster collapsing onto one machine, its fake peers all sheltering under a single juniper, has its admission bond slashed. Real distinct hardware becomes the cost of a vote.
